vendor.blurb: China's #1 by token volume; Seedance is top-tier video, while its LLMs still trail

doubao-seed-2-1-pro.tagline: Doubao's flagship for coding and agents
highlights: ByteDance says top GDPVal and MobileWorld scores, #1 on visual benchmarks like CharXiv-RQ
Preview ranked #8 on Code Arena Frontend at launch (1539), level with Opus 4.6
ByteDance says total cost on comparable workloads is nearly 80% below Opus 4.6
A 0915 build shipped 9/15 with better trusted search, VLM and 3D spatial understanding
doubao-seed-2-1-pro.notes: A deep-thinking model; not on the AA Intelligence Index or LMArena Text. The 2.2 release planned for August slipped, and 2.1 Pro has been kept going through the 0915 build.

doubao-seed-2-1-turbo.tagline: Near-Pro capability at half the price
highlights: ByteDance says capability is close to 2.1 Pro at half the price
256K context, with the same 256K max output
The default pick for enterprise high-volume calls
doubao-seed-2-1-turbo.notes: No independent third-party leaderboard results; the tier is set by marking down from 2.1 Pro.

doubao-seed-2-0-pro.tagline: The last flagship, out before Spring Gala
highlights: AIME 2025 98.3, GPQA Diamond 88.9, Codeforces 3020 (official figures)
SWE-bench Verified 76.5, BrowseComp 77.3
LMArena Text 1456, still ByteDance's only model on the text leaderboard
doubao-seed-2-0-pro.notes: A Seed 2.0 Code coding edition launched alongside at Pro pricing; not listed separately.

doubao-seed-2-0-lite.tagline: The lightweight tier for everyday Doubao chats
highlights: AIME 2025 93, GPQA Diamond 85.1 (official figures)
LiveCodeBench v6 81.7, at about 1/5 of Pro's price
doubao-seed-2-0-lite.notes: The same generation also has a cheaper Mini ($0.03/$0.31, GPQA 79), not listed separately.

seed-oss-36b.tagline: ByteDance's only open-weights LLM to date
highlights: Apache-2.0, with three variants including Base and Instruct
Trained on just 12T tokens, native 512K context
Supports an adjustable thinking budget
seed-oss-36b.notes: Released over a year ago; ByteDance has not open-sourced a newer LLM since.

seedream-5-0-pro.tagline: The design-savvy flagship for commercial imagery
highlights: LMArena Text-to-Image #10 (1256), Image Edit #8 (1394)
Pixel-level interactive editing via click, lasso, box and doodle, plus layer separation
Blends up to 10 reference images; aimed at ads, e-commerce and brand assets
seedream-5-0-pro.notes: ByteDance concedes fine-grained text rendering and edit consistency still have room to improve; the gap to GPT Image 2.5 is clear.

seedream-5-0-lite.tagline: The lightweight pick for fast everyday images
highlights: LMArena Text-to-Image #38 (1138), Image Edit #27 (1294)
AA Text-to-Image #37 (1010), priced at about 40% of Pro
seedream-5-0-lite.notes: Sources disagree on the release date: first launched before Spring Festival (2026-02), while OpenRouter lists it as added 8/13.

seedream-4-5.tagline: Last-gen workhorse, still ahead on editing
highlights: LMArena Image Edit #25 (1302), slightly above 5.0 Lite
LMArena Text-to-Image #35 (1147)
seedream-4-5.notes: Seedream 4.0 (2025-09) is still #21 on AA (1028), not listed separately.

seedance-2-5.tagline: 30 seconds in one take, 50 assets at once
highlights: Natively generates 30s in one pass; multi-round continuation reaches minutes
Takes up to 30 images + 10 videos + 10 audio clips as references
LMArena Image-to-Video #4 (1477), Text-to-Video #7 (1474)
Local regeneration, green screen, timestamp-level control; native 1080p live on fal
seedance-2-5.notes: Shown at the FORCE conference 6/23 and live on Jimeng/Doubao 7/31. Community chatter often calls it the video king. Entered the AA text-to-video v2.0 leaderboard for the first time on 9/30 at #3, 14 points behind leader Wan 3.0.

bench.AA Text-to-Video v2.0（带音频）: #3 (6,375 samples, CI 1133–1153); #1 on human anatomy and dialogue lip-sync; at $34.12/min, among the priciest in the top ten
bench.Arena Video Edit: #2 (rank range 1–3, statistically tied with Wan3.0 at 1414; 429 votes)

seedance-2-0.tagline: The one that drew Hollywood's legal letters
highlights: AA Text-to-Video #5 (1210), Image-to-Video #4 (1176)
LMArena Text-to-Video #5 (1479), scoring above its own successor 2.5
Received legal letters from Disney, Paramount, Netflix and others over IP and likeness
seedance-2-0.notes: A cheaper Seedance 2.0 Fast tier also exists; all leaderboard results are for the 720p version.

seedance-1-5-pro.tagline: ByteDance's first video model with native audio
highlights: First to add multilingual lip-sync and sound effect generation
LMArena Text-to-Video #22 (1256), Image-to-Video #24 (1307)
seedance-1-5-pro.notes: Superseded by 2.0/2.5, but the low-priced API still sees usage.
